text:
Maya: 🚀 We just crossed 10M monthly requests! Big win team 🎉 Who's up for a little celebration later today? Plushie parade + virtual fireworks?
Sam: OMG amazing!! :tada: Plushie parade sounds adorable. I will bring Mr. Narwhal.
Devon: Count me in. Also +1 for virtual fireworks — can we do a tiny confetti web app? 😂
Alex: Love it. If we're doing in-office, can we get dessert options? Cake? Mochi? (or both)
Priya: Mochi forever. If remote folks want to join, we can stream the parade and run a 3-min playlist + screen confetti. I can make a short Spotify list.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Production release v2.3.0 deployed to rwinf-prod at 14:22 UTC — no errors. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Huge thanks to infra and runtime teams for zero-downtime rollout. Pizza + mochi on me if you're in SF office.
Sam: Virtual poll: vote with emoji — :cake: for cake, :dango: for mochi, :sushi: for sushi truck. React to this thread to vote.
Devon: Also, tiny idea — bring a work-from-home plushie selfie contest. Winner gets a mystery swag box 🎁
Jamie: Can someone queue up the confetti widget? I can host a brief Zoom with screen share at 17:00 PT.
Alex: I'll handle swag box logistics. Suggest Redwood plush, sticker pack, and the mysterious tiny gong.
Priya: Playlist up: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example (add more songs)
Maya: Agenda for 17:00 PT: 1) quick shoutouts 2) plushie parade slideshow 3) confetti + GIFs 4) 10-second fireworks (virt) 5) snack time. Short and sweet.
Sam: +1 to short and sweet. I'll drop a reminder in 30m. :alarm_clock:
Devon: Congrats everyone, seriously — this is the kind of momentum that makes me proud to be here. :sparkles:
ops-bot: incident-bot: No incidents in the last 24h. All good for celebration.
Maya: OK see you all at 17:00 PT — wear or bring your weirdest plushie. :narwhal: :confetti_ball:
